maddeler.t:
Etymology tree
Egyptian msḥ
Demotic Egyptian mzḥ
Coptic ⲙⲥⲁϩ (msah)bor.?
Arabic تمساح
Possibly from Coptic ⲙⲥⲁϩ (msah), from Egyptian G17-O34:V28-I3 mzḥ (“crocodile”) with the singular feminine definite article ⲧⲉ- (te-), though ⲙⲥⲁϩ (msah) is a masculine noun in Egyptian/Coptic.
g: one of the 1976–84 models of a Mercedes Benz
